name: Entombed Stonemason
description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress’s tomb from the inside.

abilities.name: Minion (5)
abilities.description: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: The Work Never Ends
abilities.description: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason’s HP and Stress.
